name: orbital
description: Self-hosted platform for deploying, running, and managing Streamlit apps on Kubernetes

paragraphs: Self-hosted platform for deploying, running, and managing Streamlit apps — and plain static sites — on Kubernetes. Point it at a git repository and the app is live on its own subdomain minutes later, with secrets management, logs, automatic redeploys on push, and hibernation of idle apps.
features: Deploy from git — give a repo URL, branch and main file; the platform
clones, resolves dependencies (uv.lock / requirements.txt / pyproject.toml), builds an immutable container image, and deploys it behind Build/deploy status and logs stream live to the dashboard.
Static sites too — deploy a plain static site (or an npm-built SPA)
Automatic redeploys — a per-app webhook (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, or
generic) triggers a rebuild on push; unchanged dependencies reuse the cached layer for fast rebuilds.

whatItDoes.text: Self-hosted platform for deploying, running, and managing Streamlit apps — and plain static sites — on Kubernetes. Point it at a git repository and the app is live on its own subdomain minutes later, with secrets management, logs, automatic redeploys on push, and hibernation of idle apps.

requirements.text: behind OIDC login (any provider with a groups claim) with per-app viewer allowlists; the console itself has group-based admin/creator/viewer roles and per-app ownership.
